name: signup-02
title: Signup 02
description: Two columns: the form on paper, and on the desk beside it the ticket you are signing up for (admit one, stub still on), a club stamp across the corner and Stubby celebrating. The ticket shows from 48rem of width.
docs:
Installed the "Signup 02" block into your components directory under blocks/signup-02/.
Import it: import Signup02Page from "<your components alias>/blocks/signup-02/page"
Needs vee-validate@^5, vee-validate@^7, zod@^4: the CLI installs them (a project on an older major is upgraded).
